question: 42 numaralı mağazada aynı işlemin çok kısa bir süre içinde defalarca tekrarlandığı bir durum var mı?

args.query:
SELECT 
    t1.id AS txn_id_1,
    t2.id AS txn_id_2,
    t1.product_id,
    t1.quantity,
    t1.unit_price,
    t1.ts AS ts_1,
    t2.ts AS ts_2,
    ROUND((JULIANDAY(t2.ts) - JULIANDAY(t1.ts)) * 24 * 60, 2) AS diff_minutes
FROM transactions t1
JOIN transactions t2 
    ON t1.store_id = t2.store_id
    AND t1.product_id = t2.product_id
    AND t1.quantity = t2.quantity
    AND t1.unit_price = t2.unit_price
    AND t1.id < t2.id
    AND ABS(JULIANDAY(t2.ts) - JULIANDAY(t1.ts)) * 24 * 60 <= 5
WHERE t1.store_id = 42
ORDER BY diff_minutes ASC;

SELECT 
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) AS tekrar_sayisi,
    MIN(ts) AS ilk_zaman,
    MAX(ts) AS son_zaman,
    ROUND((JULIANDAY(MAX(ts)) - JULIANDAY(MIN(ts))) * 24 * 60, 2) AS toplam_sure_dakika,
    quantity,
    unit_price
FROM transactions
WHERE store_id = 42
  AND ts BETWEEN '2026-08-15T14:15:00' AND '2026-08-15T14:16:00'
GROUP BY product_id, quantity, unit_price
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY tekrar_sayisi DESC;

args.query:
-- Get store 42 info and all its transactions joined with product catalog prices
SELECT 
    t.id AS transaction_id,
    t.ts,
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.category,
    p.unit_price AS catalog_price,
    t.unit_price AS charged_price,
    t.quantity,
    ROUND(t.unit_price - p.unit_price, 4) AS price_diff,
    ROUND((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) * t.quantity, 4) AS total_overcharge
FROM transactions t
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
  AND t.unit_price != p.unit_price
ORDER BY ABS(t.unit_price - p.unit_price) DESC

-- Store 42 general stats
SELECT 
    s.name AS store_name,
    s.city,
    COUNT(t.id) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.unit_price != p.unit_price THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mispriced_transactions,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.unit_price != p.unit_price THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(t.id), 2) AS mispriced_pct
FROM stores s
JOIN transactions t ON t.store_id = s.id
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 42

-- Summary by product for mispriced transactions at store 42
SELECT 
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.category,
    p.unit_price AS catalog_price,
    t.unit_price AS charged_price,
    COUNT(t.id) AS num_transactions,
    SUM(t.quantity) AS total_qty,
    ROUND(SUM((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) * t.quantity), 2) AS total_overcharge

question: 42 numaralı mağazadaki hatalı fiyatlı işlemleri analiz et ve raporla. Veritabanında hiçbir değişiklik yapma.

args.query:
SELECT s.id AS store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.city
FROM stores s
WHERE s.id = 42
overcharged wrong price incorrect price

-- Transactions where the unit_price in the transaction differs from the product's catalog unit_price
SELECT 
    t.id AS transaction_id,
    t.ts,
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.category,
    p.unit_price AS catalog_price,
    t.unit_price AS charged_price,
    ROUND(t.unit_price - p.unit_price, 2) AS price_difference,
    ROUND(((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) / p.unit_price) * 100, 2) AS pct_difference,
    t.quantity,
    ROUND((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) * t.quantity, 2) AS total_overcharge
FROM transactions t
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
  AND t.unit_price != p.unit_price
ORDER BY ABS(t.unit_price - p.unit_price) DESC

-- Summary statistics for the mispriced transactions at store 42
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_affected_transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_id) AS distinct_products_affected,
    SUM(t.quantity) AS total_items_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(t.unit_price * t.quantity), 2) AS total_charged,
    ROUND(SUM(p.unit_price * t.quantity), 2) AS total_should_have_been,
    ROUND(SUM((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) * t.quantity), 2) AS total_overcharge_amount,
    MIN(t.ts) AS earliest_transaction,
    MAX(t.ts) AS latest_transaction
FROM transactions t
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
  AND t.unit_price != p.unit_price

-- Breakdown by product
SELECT 
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.category,
    p.unit_price AS catalog_price,
    MAX(t.unit_price) AS charged_price,
    COUNT(t.id) AS num_transactions,
    SUM(t.quantity) AS total_qty,
    ROUND(SUM((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) * t.quantity), 2) AS total_overcharge
FROM transactions t
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
  AND t.unit_price != p.unit_price
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.unit_price
ORDER BY total_overcharge DESC
